# Lumen 2.1.1

Mostly a bug-squashing, sign-in, and hardening release. After shipping `2.1.0`, I ran through a few thorough testing passes and full security audits across the desktop app, CLI, frontend, and installer, so this round focuses on built-in Google sign-in, safer uploads and deletions, Material 3 Expressive dialog polish, and locking down edge cases before they trip you up.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Built-In Google Sign-In Window:** Signing in no longer depends on finding a local Chrome or Edge install first—Lumen opens a private built-in sign-in window across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and falls back to an external Chromium browser or manual token entry when needed.
- **Per-Account Circuit Breaker & 30s Cooldown:** When Google rate-limits, signs out, or restricts an account, uploads (including file pickers, watched folders, and drag-and-drop) are locked for that account until the issue is cleared, with a live 30-second countdown on temporary rate limits and automatic bearer token refresh on mid-batch 401 expiries.
- **Delete-After-Backup & Dry-Run Safety:** Local files are never deleted from a stale local hash-cache hit without verifying with Google Photos first or when a requested album wasn't attached, and `lumen-cli` now properly inherits your saved `dry_run` preference.
- **Real iPhone Live Photo Pairing & Transient Network Retries:** Fixed Apple iOS MakerNote IFD offset parsing and widened QuickTime metadata scanning so real iPhone `HEIC` + `MOV` pairs match reliably, and fixed `reqwest` timeout/network error classification so temporary connection drops retry cleanly without erasing resumable upload sessions.
- **Launch & Background Update Checks:** Lumen now checks for updates automatically when opened and periodically in the background, sending a localized desktop notification when a new release is ready, with a toggle in Settings → Background to turn auto-checks off.
- **Update Checker Cache & Proxy Fixes:** Automatic and manual update checks share the same checker, honor your configured proxy settings, preserve cached release notes on `304 Not Modified`, and handle `-dev` or pre-release version tags accurately.
- **Windows Notifications & Dev/Release Isolation:** Registered Lumen's Windows `AppUserModelID` and Start Menu shortcut properties so desktop notifications display the proper Lumen name and icon, and fully isolated dev builds (`Lumen Dev`) from release installs.
- **Hardware Battery Detection:** Desktop PCs without a battery automatically hide the "Pause on battery power" setting, and macOS AC-power detection no longer false-triggers while charging on low-wattage adapters.
- **Linux ARM64 Support & Date Recovery:** Official releases now include native `linux-arm64` builds for both the desktop app (`.AppImage`, `.deb`, and standalone binary) and `lumen-cli`, and date-from-filename recovery handles `IMG_YYYYMMDD`, `PXL_`, dashed dates, and social-app timestamps.
- **Watched Folders, CLI & Installer Fixes:** Watched-folder "Back Up Now" uses each folder's own account, album, and subfolder settings with `delete_from_host` disabled, CLI explicit `=false` flags override saved `true` preferences, Windows directory browsing auto-appends the `Lumen` folder name, silent uninstall (`--silent`) runs headlessly, and system-tray-less desktops no longer hide on window close.

---

### Interface & Dialog Polish
- **Markdown Changelog Viewer:** The "Update Available" dialog now renders GitHub release notes with headings, lists, code blocks, task checkboxes, and safe external links instead of plain raw text.
- **Material 3 Expressive Dialogs & Drop Zone Overhaul:** Reworked all modal dialogs, scrims, and focus traps (including stacked `alertdialog` handling) to Material 3 Expressive specs, relocated the active queue drop zone beneath the hero card with spring morphing and balanced column heights, and refined the Account Safety copy.
- **Reliable Settings, Albums & Localization:** Album dialog cancel snapshots and restores prior selections, custom album nicknames stay reactive and per-account, failed setting saves roll back cleanly without dropping adjacent toggles, and localized worker status labels, notifications, and the About tagline (`Google Photos`) are consistent across English, Spanish, Indonesian, and Japanese.

---

### Security Hardening
- **Isolated Embedded Sign-In & CDP Cleanup:** Restricted the built-in sign-in window to HTTPS navigation (blocking `tauri.localhost`/`ipc.localhost`, popups, and Tauri IPC), bound URL token extraction strictly to `accounts.google.com`, required HTTPS-only `oauth_token` cookies from `google.com`, failed closed on unsupported proxies, and ensured external CDP Chromium process trees and temp profiles are cleaned up on cancel or exit.
- **Tightened Desktop IPC, CSP & Log Anonymizer:** Removed unused plugin permissions from Tauri capabilities (`opener:default`, `dialog:default`, `notification:default`), added `object-src 'none'`, `base-uri 'self'`, `form-action 'none'`, and `frame-ancestors 'none'` CSP directives, disabled DevTools shortcuts in release builds, and eliminated catastrophic regex backtracking in the Developer log anonymizer.
- **Hardened Installer & Release Pipelines:** Passed dynamic PowerShell paths via environment variables with Unicode single-quote escaping, replaced recursive legacy/uninstall deletion with reparse-point-safe `Remove-DirSafe`, rejected symlinks/devices in tar extraction and `\\.\` device prefixes, blocked release installer builds with placeholder payloads, pinned all GitHub Actions to verified commit SHAs, and enforced `persist-credentials: false` plus tag/exit-code validation across `.github/workflows`.
